760090201.text: Hmm... Doesn't seem to be this one either...

760090202.text: #Oh, hello there, {M#Big Bro}{F#Big Sis}. I don't think I've seen you before... or the white fae lady next to you.

760090203.text: Welcome to the Frostmoon Enclave! Is there anything I can help you with?

760090204.text: #Nope, we just got curious, seeing you out here all alone like this. By the way, Paimon's Paimon, and this is {NICKNAME}!

760090205.text: #So it's {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} {NICKNAME} and Miss Paimon! Hmm... Y'know, you two don't look like you're from Nasha Town.

760090207.text: Yup! Super awesome adventurers, at that!

760090211.text: Must be nice though — traveling around with your best friend, seeing the world together...

760090212.text: It really is! We've been to so many places already! What about you? What were you doing out here just now?

760090213.text: I was looking for pretty stones.

760090214.text: Oh, Paimon gets it! You collect them, right? You're not the only one — some grown-ups are super into that too!

760090215.text: Nope! I'm gonna use the pretty stones to bribe Mai into kidnapping me.

760090216.text: Okay, that makes sen— wait, what!?

760090209.text: #Whoa, seriously? That sounds so cool! Can I be your follower then, {NICKNAME}? You know, like in one of those epic stories?

760090210.text: Hey, quit messing around! We're just regular adventurers passing through, okay!? No way we're secretly pulling all the strings in Nasha Town or anything... at least, not that Paimon knows of...

760090301.text: #I know I'm not a kid anymore, but I still need to grow a bit to reach that high. Could you give me a hand, {NICKNAME}?

760090501.text: We're back! Kasha, would you consider this a pretty stone?

760090502.text: Wow, that was fast! You really are professional adventurers. You're amazing!

760090503.text: Hehe, most stuff's easy-peasy for us! Short of exploring some crazy-deep underground labyrinth, or taking photos at spots thousands of miles apart, maybe...

760090506.text: Hmm... It's a beautiful stone, sure, but I feel like it seems to be attracted to this big stone...

760090507.text: Really? Paimon doesn't feel anything at all.

760090508.text: I'm not really sure either... It's just a vague hunch, I guess.

760090509.text: It's like... how Mai mentioned that Reed Miller encountered the fae princess through the guidance of the Moon Goddess. I guess this premonition of mine must be something similar...?

760090510.text: Wow, is this what they call foresight? But wait — Paimon's pretty sure the Moon Goddess wouldn't bother with something like that... She's probably way too busy for that kind of thing!

760090511.text: So... what does your premonition tell you to do?

760090512.text: Hmm... For example, that we should put this stone back there?

760090513.text: #I know I'm not a kid anymore, but I still need to grow a bit to reach that high. Could you give me a hand, {NICKNAME}?

subQuests.subQuestName: Place the fragment(s) on the stone

760090601.text: Wow, I was right! As soon as we put the two stones together, something really awesome happened!

760090602.text: Umm, but now the stone we just found is gone...

760090603.text: Oh, it's okay! I was only trying to find fragments like that so I could bribe Mai in the first place...

760090604.text: Now that we've got this whole new story about a flying stone, the stone itself doesn't really matter anymore. Since Mai loves telling stories, I'm sure she'll be way more excited about this tale than just some old rocks!

760090605.text: #Thank you so much, {NICKNAME} and Paimon! Things didn't go exactly as I imagined, but I'm really happy with how it all turned out!

760090606.text: Oh! And here's a pretty stone I found earlier. I think it's really beautiful, so I want you to have it as a thank-you gift!

760090101.text: Thank you so much! It would be great if I could find <color=#00E1FFFF>pretty stones</color> nearby...
